Name: (CP) Doors Decor (Yellog's Wood Buildings)

As requested by some users, this is a simple recolor of the new door decor items introduced in the 1.6 update to match [url=https://yellog.postype.com/post/11565362]Yellog's Wood Buildings[/url].
